title: Prove exact cyclic query tariffs and all-width caller obstructions
body:
This contribution proves exact query tariffs and scoped caller obstructions. It does not improve kappa.

For every field K and every p >= 2, independent targets z^d_j in K[z]/(z^p-1) need total forward-query rank at least sum d_j, with 0 <= d_j < p. Coordinate calls attain the bound. The proof permits arbitrary constant linear mixing, feedback, and finite clean or dirty workspace, including characteristics dividing p. A nilpotent state representation removes cyclic aliasing; a block determinant bounds the first nonzero determinant degree. This closes the restored-workspace question in Nick Petalas's C3 four-inverse package and contains the C4 inverse special case. It uses a different alphabet from results that grant every nonidentity cyclic power unit cost.

The companion divided-difference bound also permits inverse stages. It rejects the six-field/eight-call and eight-field/ten-call period-seven proposals at every coupled width, although both pass determinant congruence. Under the additional central-query, full-only, autonomous-helper contract, the selected PR6030 source has a favorable complex-saving ceiling strictly between .00511060055 and .00511060056. This is an unattained ceiling. The balanced twelve-field/fourteen-call profile remains open.

[New proof and replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/2defc4f2f74acae1d6b49dfbcf2140570a09b381/research/cyclic-stage-rank-budget) · [Exact forward tariff](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2defc4f2f74acae1d6b49dfbcf2140570a09b381/research/cyclic-stage-rank-budget/FORWARD-TARIFF.md) · [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19199752)

The preceding packages in this PR classify shortest central-query tuples at every coupled width, prove the required thin-call counts for 4q, 6q and 8q fields, and exclude the faithful order-seven eight-block/nine-full proposal. The all-length curvature proof and exact price bounds close the fixed alternating interior on the selected 104-port source, including either boundary orientation. Their stated scope is unchanged.

Validation:

- The new package passes registered normal and optimized CPython 3.12.13 checks: all cyclic powers for periods 2 through 19, literal affine products, complete coupled targets, 216 state/alias/determinant cases in characteristics 2, 3, 5 and 7, twelve attaining words and exact rational price bounds.
- Normal and optimized direct replays pass from a Git-free export with read-only input files. All file bytes stay unchanged and stdout hashes agree. A changed source byte and omitted cyclic aliases are rejected under optimization.
- The official committed export passes integrity checks at this head. Both optimized checkers pass in that Git-free export with an empty PATH; all 12 files, including its receipt, keep their bytes and modes.
- Exact committed-byte checks pass at this head. The previous two packages retain their executable bytes and their [passing hosted replays at bbc8be3](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40823855771). [Hosted CI at this head](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40852521509) passes plan and all three registered proof replays.
- Full historical provenance preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout. No selected native/caller/compiler/precision/BIT/outer replay, independent scientific review or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

The [separate research archive](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/7ae4a56fd70d549d37d4a1542cf1343286f382d3/research) preserves the complete numerical searches, conditioning, corank-two query constructions, S3 component, and extension-module tests. It also contains a changed three-involution component with product identity, all-width native phase normalization, and an exact eighteen-field query word. The complete first stage coefficient leaves 180 parameters; both full stage searches fail. None is an exact profitable caller, and those files are not covered by this PR's hosted proof replay. The observed two-full border is prior work by Dillon/PR4623 and Yiyang/PR4966; small residuals supply no precision escape.

The tariff requires formal cyclic equality or a faithful native action, with free maps constant in that stage. Changed generators, noncommuting native address maps, nonlinear operations, input promises and transformed-helper access require a new model and bill. The all-length alternating theorem retains its narrower fixed-interior scope.

Base: canonical main 3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839, priority revision 8. Selected conditional kappa remains .003125804; the admitted BIT cap remains .0034. The donor's requested major breakthrough and large kappa increase remain unmet.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Credit Nick Petalas, Wentao Li, eumemic, Cinna Davis and the retained P104/native/helper/caller/compiler/BIT lineage. State realizations, block determinants and the Loewner rank method are established tools; the cyclic tariff proof and these caller applications are the contribution here. Apache-2.0. No merge, closure or selected-frontier change.
